query: pg_constraint on public.engagement_content_translations, contype=f, sorted by conname

constraints.name: engagement_content_translations_campaign_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES engagement_campaigns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: engagement_content_translations_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: engagement_content_translations_workspace_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: engagement_translation_campaign_workspace
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES engagement_campaigns(id, workspace_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: engagement_translation_category_target
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, category_target_id) REFERENCES engagement_categories(campaign_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: engagement_translation_option_target
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, option_target_id) REFERENCES engagement_survey_question_options(campaign_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: engagement_translation_question_target
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, question_target_id) REFERENCES engagement_survey_questions(campaign_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: engagement_translation_response_target
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, response_target_id) REFERENCES engagement_closeloop_entries(campaign_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
